name: Taylor
goal: Taylor hopes the group can come up with a party plan that truly reflects Steve's interests and personality, making the surprise a meaningful and enjoyable celebration for him.
backstory: Taylor has known Steve since college and remembers how much he loved the surprise party they threw for him during their junior year, which is why Taylor thinks a secret birthday party would be perfect for Steve's upcoming celebration. Having helped plan that previous party, Taylor has some ideas on how to make this one just as memorable. Taylor personally prefers outdoor venues and hopes they can find a suitable location.

beliefs.concession: if the group is clearly prioritizing Steve's favorite foods over location

name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes to create an unconventional birthday experience for Steve that subverts his expectations and doesn't feel like every other generic celebration.
backstory: Quinn has helped plan a few surprise parties in the past, but one notable failure still lingers, where the guest of honor walked in on the setup crew. Quinn prefers low-key celebrations and thinks Steve might appreciate that too. Having seen how quickly party details can leak, Quinn is keen on keeping this event tightly under wraps.

beliefs.concession: if the group is willing to keep the event strictly private and under wraps

name: Riley
goal: Riley hopes that the party planning process will result in a memorable and personalized celebration that truly reflects Steve's interests and preferences.
backstory: Riley has always been the life of the party and loves surprises, but only if they're done right - their best friend's birthday bash last year was a total disaster due to poor planning. As someone who values unique experiences, Riley has a soft spot for bespoke events that reflect the celebrant's personality. Having recently tried a new restaurant with an amazing dessert menu, Riley thinks Steve would love a similar culinary-focused celebration.

beliefs.concession: if the group is willing to incorporate a unique dessert menu into the chosen option
